name: Fichtean curve
shape: the story opens inside the first crisis and climbs through crises of different kinds to a climax, with almost no preamble and a short aftermath
reading: The story opens already inside its first crisis, the study door coming down and the key pocketed, and it never gets a calm stretch: each turn is a new kind of squeeze in the same snowbound house, the room that holds the truth being swept closer every hour. It should build to a single accusation in the drawing room, with the carriage at the door, and land hard and briefly: the name either holds or the house's verdict goes down the road instead, and there is only a short morning after.
why: Its opening crisis is the broken door in turn 1, its second and third crises are the dinner-table verdict and the dawn clearing of the study, which is the escalating 3b.primary_trajectory over the hours_to_days of 3e.timeline_duration inside the single building of 3f.setting_scale; its climax is the drawing-room naming where the hard, terminal failure of 3-0c (incorrect_resolution) is met, and its short aftermath is all the story needs after that. seven_point also fits the single_fork and designed gap, but it wants a hook-to-opposite transformation and a preamble before its first turn; this story has no preamble and its housekeeper does not change in kind, she is squeezed until she must speak.
